title: Add Two Numbers
task: Given two nonempty linked lists representing nonnegative integers in reverse digit order, add the numbers and return the result as a linked list.
knowledge_profile: Understands loops and basic linked lists but struggles with pointer traversal and carrying values between digit additions.

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
task: Given a string, find the length of its longest substring containing no repeated characters.
knowledge_profile: Understands strings and loops but struggles with sliding windows and tracking the most recent occurrence of a character.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring
task: Given a string, return its longest contiguous substring that reads the same forward and backward.
knowledge_profile: Understands string indexing but struggles with expanding around centers and handling odd- and even-length palindromes.

title: 3Sum
task: Given an integer array, find all unique triplets whose three values sum to zero.
knowledge_profile: Understands sorting and nested loops but struggles with two-pointer techniques and avoiding duplicate triplets.

title: Container With Most Water
task: Given heights representing vertical lines, choose two lines that together with the horizontal axis contain the greatest possible amount of water.
knowledge_profile: Understands arrays and arithmetic but struggles with two-pointer movement and explaining why discarding one boundary is valid.

title: Group Anagrams
task: Group together all strings that are anagrams of one another and return the groups in any order.
knowledge_profile: Understands dictionaries and strings but struggles with choosing a consistent dictionary key for equivalent character arrangements.

title: Product of Array Except Self
task: Return an array where each position contains the product of all input values except the value at that position, without using division.
knowledge_profile: Understands loops and arrays but struggles with prefix and suffix products and combining information from two directions.

title: Top K Frequent Elements
task: Given an integer array and an integer k, return the k values that occur most frequently.
knowledge_profile: Understands dictionaries and sorting but struggles with frequency counting and selecting the k highest-frequency values.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
task: Given an unsorted integer array, find the length of its longest sequence of consecutive integer values in O(n) time.
knowledge_profile: Understands sets and loops but struggles with identifying sequence starts and preventing repeated work.

title: Valid Sudoku
task: Determine whether a partially filled 9-by-9 Sudoku board is valid according to row, column, and 3-by-3 box constraints.
knowledge_profile: Understands nested loops and sets but struggles with tracking constraints across rows, columns, and subgrids.

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
task: Search for a target in a rotated sorted array of distinct integers in O(log n) time. Return its index or -1 if absent.
knowledge_profile: Understands binary search but struggles with identifying which half remains sorted and choosing the correct search boundary.

title: Combination Sum
task: Given distinct positive candidate numbers and a target, find all unique combinations whose values sum to the target. A candidate can be used repeatedly.
knowledge_profile: Understands functions and lists but struggles with recursive backtracking, stopping conditions, and avoiding duplicate combinations.

title: Permutations
task: Given a list of distinct integers, return every possible ordering of those integers.
knowledge_profile: Understands recursion at a basic level but struggles with choosing unused elements and restoring state during backtracking.

title: Merge Intervals
task: Given intervals, merge all overlapping intervals and return the resulting nonoverlapping intervals.
knowledge_profile: Understands lists and comparisons but struggles with sorting intervals and updating interval boundaries.

title: Rotate Image
task: Rotate an n-by-n matrix 90 degrees clockwise in place.
knowledge_profile: Understands nested lists and indexing but struggles with coordinate transformations and in-place swaps.

title: Spiral Matrix
task: Given a matrix, return its elements in clockwise spiral order, starting at the top-left corner.
knowledge_profile: Understands nested loops but struggles with updating four traversal boundaries and preventing duplicate visits.

title: Set Matrix Zeroes
task: If a matrix cell contains zero, set every cell in its row and column to zero. Modify the matrix in place.
knowledge_profile: Understands matrices and loops but struggles with preventing newly written zeros from affecting later decisions.

title: House Robber
task: Given the amount of money in each house, determine the maximum amount that can be collected without robbing two adjacent houses.
knowledge_profile: Understands loops and conditionals but struggles with dynamic programming states and comparing choices at each position.

title: Number of Islands
task: Given a grid of land and water cells, count the connected islands. Land cells connect horizontally or vertically.
knowledge_profile: Understands nested lists and conditionals but struggles with graph traversal, visited cells, and recursive or iterative exploration.

title: Coin Change
task: Given coin denominations and a target amount, return the minimum number of coins needed to make that amount, or -1 if it is impossible. Each denomination can be used unlimited times.
knowledge_profile: Understands loops and arrays but struggles with dynamic programming, unreachable states, and building solutions from smaller amounts.
